fnol_text: My name is Owen Thorne and I live at 792 Linden Lane, Clinton, NC 28363. You can reach me on (555) 421-7007 or owen.thorne@example.com. The Fenley Creek burst its banks on 31 December 2025 and the water came right up the garden and into the house. The ground floor was under about 40 cm of water. Policy HH-2024-00065. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Thorne on (555) 421-7007 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 31 December 2025.
Site visit to 792 Linden Lane. Neighbour Gabriel Castillo was present and confirmed the timeline.
Owen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
